(Japanese: 世界の行方 The Course of the World) is the 74th chapter of the Pokémon RéBURST manga.
==Plot==
 
==Major events==
Ryouga is defeated by Fraud.
Fraud flies off to the Eternal Tower.
Fraud meets Pauline again and announces to the world of his plans of wiping out all humans and Pokémon.
Garyū meets Ryouga in his mind.
Ryouga completely fuses with , gaining its tail in the process.
